exact: regulation of branching involved in salivary gland morphogenesis by epithelial-mesenchymal signalling

definition: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of salivary gland branching as a result of the transfer of information from the epithelial cells to the mesenchymal cells of the salivary gland.
label: regulation of branching involved in salivary gland morphogenesis by epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
